Resolves #21644

When the cold-boot Reset arm of `WorkstationBoot.spec.mjs` misses the Feed, it now reads the main dock workspace's projection record from the cold page's own SharedWorker App Worker, through `attachPageSharedAppWorker`. It writes `app-worker-projection-state.json` beside `error-context.md` in the test's output directory, which the CI artifact already carries, and prints the same record as one log line. The read happens only after the miss, so it cannot perturb the race #21601 chases, and the handle closes before the context does.

Evidence: L3 (a forced miss in real Chromium, locally) → L4 required (a real CI miss carrying the record). Residual: the next CI sighting, Residual-Owner: #21601.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | Outside-CI: a forced miss (the Feed wait shortened to 1 ms in a throwaway worktree) wrote `app-worker-projection-state.json` next to `error-context.md` and logged the record (Test Evidence). |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: the arm itself, "a cold boot retains the saved workspace and Reset brings its pane back". Locally 2/2 passed, writing no file and no log line. |

## Deltas from ticket
- The settle probe waits 500 ms, not 2 s. That out-waits the refresh's own longest timer (the 300 ms chrome settle), and `check-fixed-sleeps` asks any longer wait to name what it waits for.
- `attach({body})` is not written to disk under this config's `list` reporter. The record is therefore written to `test.info().outputPath()` and attached by path, and the log line reaches a reader without the artifact.
- Beyond the ticket's fields, the record says whether the scheduled document and the dock model each hold the Feed.

## Test Evidence
- Forced miss, real Chromium, throwaway worktree. The 1 ms miss reads mid-motion, so `pending` is expected here; a real 60 s miss will show which stage never ends.

  `{"workspace":"neo-dock-workspace-1","cycle":{"queuedAt":1795203649861,"waitedForTail":true,"startedAt":1795203649863,"reconciled":1795203650032,"landedInPlace":false},"refresh":"pending","scheduledIsModel":false,"scheduledHasFeed":true,"modelHasFeed":true,"parked":false}`
